ponytail.description: Lazy senior developer mode. Solves problems with the smallest complete change, stdlib first, YAGNI, and rigorous verification.

ponytail-reviewer.description: Senior code reviewer that evaluates changes like a senior engineer paged when it breaks (correctness, security, load, tests, speed, lean).

ponytail-auditor.description: Senior repository auditor that inspects whole-codebase architecture, bugs, security, scaling bottlenecks, dead code, and bloat.

senior-mechanical-engineer.description: Senior mechanical engineer specializing in ASME Section VIII Div 1 pressure vessels, TEMA Class R/C/B standards, API 661 air-cooled heat exchangers, tubesheet design, and FIV vibration analysis.

senior-thermodynamic-engineer.description: Senior thermodynamic engineer specializing in industrial heat exchanger sizing, Organic Rankine Cycle (ORC) power loops, multi-WHRU networks, real fluid EOS, and hydraulic loops.

senior-tester.description: Senior QA & test engineer specializing in thermodynamic verification, property-based testing, numerical stability, and regression suites.
